correctness.rationale: Set B=diag(r+delta,r-delta)-Q, E=exp(-L sqrt(B/D)), F=B^{-1}(I-E). The first-excursion survival integral is F, and the phase-preserving reset kernel is F Lambda. Strong Markov at reset gives (I-F Lambda)m=F 1, equivalently m=(h_L(B)-Q)^(-1)1; this does not falsely reinitialize the environmental phase. The symmetric/antisymmetric 2x2 spectral projector has eigenvalues r+nu±sqrt(nu²+delta²) and weights c,1-c, giving the stated mean. As L downarrow0, Jensen for b^(-1/2) and barycenter r forces a positive difference from constant rate; as L increases, b_-<r gives exponential ratio zero. Numerical independent matrix-renewal reconstruction agreed with scalar formula at 15 test parameter-distance combinations to 1e-7 relative (ill-conditioned at L=10 with large mean); e.g D=r=nu=1,delta=.5: at L=.02 0.0209616>0.0202013, L=8 2190.9232<2979.9580. No claim of unique crossing.
